integrity: Proof by explicit operation identities and full finite rank counts; independent mathematical audit not performed. Published representation theorem is expressly prior input, not claimed here.
scientific_limitations: The homomorphism normal form assumes finite regular L-algebras represented as finite integer downsets; the product hom-set formula requires a rectangular target; the monoid and rank/retract formulas are for homogeneous boxes. A full-text originality comparison to Rump (2008) remains unavailable. The code checks finite instances only.
title: Coordinate-scaled homomorphisms and pointed-transformation spectra of finite regular \(L\)-algebras
